--
title:"Blood Activity"
format: html
--

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import plotly.express as px
import plotly.graph_objects as go
import numpy as np
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.decomposition import PCA
```

```{python}
blood = pd.read_csv("../data/blood.csv")
blood.head()
```

```{python}
X = blood[["lbxsatsi", "lbxsassi", "lbdstpsi", "lbxsnasi",
           "lbxsclsi", "lbxsossi", "lbdsgbsi"]].copy()
```

```{python}
X.dropna(inplace=True)
```

```{python}
cormat = round(X.corr(numeric_only=True), 2)
```

```{python}
mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(cormat, dtype = bool))
```

```{python}
col = sns.diverging_palette(255, 0, as_cmap = True)
```

```{python}
plt.figure(figsize = (12, 6))
sns.heatmap(cormat, mask = mask, annot = True, cmap = col)
plt.show();
```

```{python}
scaler = StandardScaler()
```

```{python}
X_std = scaler.fit_transform(X)
```

```{python}
pca = PCA(n_components=2)
```

```{python}
pca_fit = pca.fit(X_std)
```

```{python}
scores = pca_fit.transform(X_std)
```

```{python}
pca_df = pd.DataFrame(scores, columns = ["PC1", "PC2"])
```

```{python}
## Scatter plot
fig = px.scatter(pca_df.reset_index(),
                 x = "PC1",
                 y = "PC2",
                 hover_name = "index",
                 hover_data = {"index": False},
                 template = "plotly_white",
                 opacity = 0.3)

## Color de los puntos
fig.update_traces(marker = dict(color = "dodgerblue"))

## Líneas de referencia
fig.add_vline(x = 0, line_width = 1,
              line_dash = "dash",
              line_color = "gray")
fig.add_hline(y = 0, line_width = 1,
              line_dash = "dash",
              line_color = "gray")

## Formato de los ejes
fig.update_xaxes(showline = True,
                 linewidth = 1,
                 linecolor = "black",
                 mirror = True,
                 showgrid = True,
                 gridcolor = "lightgray",
                 zeroline = False)
fig.update_yaxes(showline = True,
                 linewidth = 1,
                 linecolor = "black",
                 mirror = True,
                 showgrid = True,
                 gridcolor = "lightgray",
                 zeroline = False)
fig.update_layout(width = 500, height = 500)
fig.show()
```

```{python}
loadings = pca_fit.components_.T
```

```{python}
colors = px.colors.qualitative.Dark24
```

```{python}
features = X.columns
```

```{python}
## Gráfica de los vectores
fig = px.scatter(template = "plotly_white")
for i, feature in enumerate(features):
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x = [0, loadings[i, 0]],
        y = [0, loadings[i, 1]],
        mode = "lines+markers",
        name = feature,
        line = dict(color = colors[i],
                    width = 2),
        marker = dict(symbol = "arrow",
                      size = [0, 14],
                      angleref = "previous", color = colors[i]),
        hovertemplate = (f"<b>{feature}</b><br>"
                       f"PC1: {loadings[i, 0]:.3f}<br>"
                       f"PC2: {loadings[i, 1]:.3f}<extra></extra>"),
        legend = "legend1"))
fig.update_layout(legend1 = dict(title = "Variables",
                                 yanchor = "top"))

## Líneas de referencia
fig.add_vline(x = 0, line_width = 1,
              line_dash = "dash",
              line_color = "gray")
fig.add_hline(y = 0, line_width = 1,
              line_dash = "dash",
              line_color = "gray")

## Formato de los ejes
fig.update_xaxes(showline = True,
                 linewidth = 1,
                 linecolor = "black",
                 mirror = True,
                 showgrid = True,
                 gridcolor = "lightgray",
                 zeroline = False)
fig.update_yaxes(showline = True,
                 linewidth = 1,
                 linecolor = "black",
                 mirror = True,
                 showgrid = True,
                 gridcolor = "lightgray",
                 zeroline = False)
fig.update_xaxes(title_text = "PC1")
fig.update_yaxes(title_text = "PC2")
fig.update_layout(width = 600, height = 500)
fig.show()
```

```{python}
pca_df_scaled = pca_df.copy()
```

```{python}
scaler = 1/(pca_df_scaled.max() - pca_df_scaled.min())
```

```{python}
for index in scaler.index:
    pca_df_scaled[index] = pca_df_scaled[index] * scaler[index]
```

```{python}
## Observaciones
fig = px.scatter(pca_df_scaled.reset_index(),
                 x = "PC1",
                 y = "PC2",
                 hover_name = "index",
                 hover_data = {"index": False},
                 template = "plotly_white",
                 opacity = 0.3,
                 title = "Biplot",
                 render_mode = "svg")
fig.update_traces(marker = dict(color = "dodgerblue"))

## Variables
for i, feature in enumerate(features):
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x = [0, loadings[i, 0]],
        y = [0, loadings[i, 1]],
        mode = "lines+markers",
        name = feature,
        line = dict(color = colors[i],
                    width = 2),
        marker = dict(symbol = "arrow",
                      size = [0, 14],
                      angleref = "previous", color = colors[i]),
        hovertemplate = (f"<b>{feature}</b><br>"
                       f"PC1: {loadings[i, 0]:.3f}<br>"
                       f"PC2: {loadings[i, 1]:.3f}<extra></extra>"),
        legend = "legend1"))
fig.update_layout(legend1 = dict(title = "Variables",
                                 yanchor = "top"))

## Formato de los ejes
fig.add_vline(x = 0, line_width = 1,
              line_dash = "dash",
              line_color = "gray")
fig.add_hline(y = 0, line_width = 1,
              line_dash = "dash",
              line_color = "gray")
fig.update_xaxes(showline = True,
                 linewidth = 1,
                 linecolor = "black",
                 mirror = True,
                 showgrid = True,
                 gridcolor = "lightgray",
                 zeroline = False)
fig.update_yaxes(showline = True,
                 linewidth = 1,
                 linecolor = "black",
                 mirror = True,
                 showgrid = True,
                 gridcolor = "lightgray",
                 zeroline = False)
fig.update_layout(width = 600, height = 500)
fig.show()
```
